programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU (SIT KA YIN, NANCY) met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI (KWOK FUNG) and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO (SHEH CHARMAINE) and her adopted child, MAN CHOR (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN). Having been abandoned by her lover, CHOR's mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN (MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN) appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING (TONG MICHAEL). CHOR's voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HO's future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HO's heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Cho Lam & His Trip Buddies & What's On Today
programme.desc: After his "One-Stroke-Wear" journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series' authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, he'll be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lam's life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouver—three distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of "travel friends," exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspect—his romantic destiny—telling his unique story through travel snippets.

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: The Truth Within & What's On Today
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Fei's death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Fei's true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.

programme.title: Neighborhood Treasures (Sr.7)
programme.desc: Sammy and Kitty, this quirky duo, reunite on screen, this time as secret agent leaders, delivering hilarious clips from Taiwan, Japan, and Hong Kong to the audience. programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: The Truth Within & What's On Today
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Fei's death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Fei's true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.

programme.title: Cho Lam & His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: After his "One-Stroke-Wear" journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series' authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, he'll be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lam's life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouver—three distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of "travel friends," exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspect—his romantic destiny—telling his unique story through travel snippets.

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.

programme.title: News At 18:30 & Global View & What's On Today
programme.desc: Jade Channel reports important local, cross-strait, and international news every afternoon at 6:30.

programme.title: EXTRA
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kong's entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audience—ensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment.

programme.title: News Roundup
programme.desc: Reporting major news from Hong Kong, across the Taiwan Strait, and around the world, as well as sports updates, keeping you informed about important events and trends in the world of sports.

programme.title: Fist Fight
programme.desc: Certified Protection Officer (CPO) HA TIN-HANG (Mat Yeung) is relocated from England to Hong Kong on a mission to protect a web leader named CHEUNG FEI-FAN (Vincent Wong), while searching for his birth family. Flamboyant and conceited FEI-FAN holds a sham boxing championship to cover the arrival of hackers, but gets himself into trouble in the process, fortunately TIN-HANG manages to help him out. The incident attracts the attention of a hot-headed cop named HO TIT-NAM (Philip Ng), who relentlessly probes into the matter. It turns out that TIT-NAM made an unspeakable mistake on impulse, resulting in a radical change of his personality. With the boxing championship rousing their combative instincts, the gradual discovery of their telepathic abilities enables them to help each other through that common bond. Such an underlying close connection can even be traced back to a financial crisis twenty years ago……

programme.title: Brother's Keeper
programme.desc: Qiao Tiansheng (Ruco Chan) and Luo Weixin (Edwin Siu) are half-brothers, separated by fate in Hong Kong and Macau, respectively, and subjected to the harsh realities of a turbulent historical era. Their mother, Zhou Yumei (Louise Lee), raises Weixin in Macau as a black market operator. With hard work and the help of his friends Yao Wenying (Kristal Tin) and Long Fei (Yuen Siu-cheung), Weixin overcomes numerous hardships and challenges to achieve success. Meanwhile, Tiansheng, struggling to make ends meet in Hong Kong, takes a shortcut, associating with a triad member, Jiang Yong (Louis Cheung), and having an affair with a wealthy woman, leaving his girlfriend, Zhuo Jing (Linda Chung), heartbroken and ultimately losing both his money and his girlfriend. Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Every Step You Take
programme.desc: Due to an accident, magazine photographer SUNG TIN-CHUNG (Myolie Wu) not only lost her parents but also her sight. Nevertheless, born to be aesthete, TIN-CHUNG, who loves binge-watching TV drama, never gives up on herself. Accompanied by her boyfriend TO CHING-HENG (Jonathan Cheung) and a guide dog, she gradually rebuilds her lost confidence, and an advertising slogan "With Love, Nothing is Impossible" even becomes her motto, helping her let go of her sorrows. Unknown to her, the advertising producer, KAM YIN-CHUNG (Moses Chan), is actually her next-door neighbour. Work addict YIN-CHUNG cannot keep friends and co-workers, not even his apprentice YUEN YUEN (Elaine Yiu), who wants to resign. Feeling rather puzzled, YIN-CHUNG decides to take a long vacation and move back to his former residence, and in the meantime to get back in touch with his old friend YU KA-KING (Mak Cheung Ching). While it's the best opportunity for YIN-CHUNG to start anew, it also helps him gain a better understanding of himself. With her boyfriend having a change of heart, TIN-CHUNG is once again at the lowest ebb, fortunately, she still has YIN-CHUNG by her side as her guardian angel. Though they are poles apart in personality, the chemistry between them ignites the spark of love. So you think you can see? However, there might still be a blind spot. Whereas vision impairment doesn't deter one from seeing the light......

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Executioner, The
programme.desc: In order to protect his benefactor's daughter-in-law, YUEN SO-SUM (Elaine Yiu), throughout her pregnancy and childbirth, cold-blooded executioner YIP SHEUNG-LUK (Kenny Wong) arranges for SO-SUM to settle down in the home of a renowned midwife in town, FA YUI-HUNG (Maggie Shiu). As such, they run into an obscure murder, and SHEUNG-LUK even uses his saber to help save a new life. Due to the unknown background of this newborn baby boy, SHEUNG-LUK and YUI-HUNG are involuntarily caught up in the whirlwind of political infighting. As a team, they play cohesively and competently despite being poles apart in personality, managing to avert disaster over and over again. Slowly, their love grows in the face of adversity. On the other hand, childhood sweethearts CHIK CHI-TSAU (Matt Yeung) and CHUK SIU-MOON (Katy Kung), who grow up together in a brothel, arrive at YUI-HUNG's home, beseeching SHEUNG-LUK to take CHI-TSAU as his apprentice. In fact, CHI-TSAU is up to something as he attempts to take advantage of this to avoid punishment, so SHEUNG-LUK cannot make up his mind. With the sudden appearance of a mysterious magician, SZEMA CAU (Joel Chan), they all get entangled in complicated relationships. Gradually, the real identity of the baby boy is unmasked, sounding the death knell in the meantime......

programme.title: Fist Fight
programme.desc: Certified Protection Officer (CPO) HA TIN-HANG (Mat Yeung) is relocated from England to Hong Kong on a mission to protect a web leader named CHEUNG FEI-FAN (Vincent Wong), while searching for his birth family. Flamboyant and conceited FEI-FAN holds a sham boxing championship to cover the arrival of hackers, but gets himself into trouble in the process, fortunately TIN-HANG manages to help him out. The incident attracts the attention of a hot-headed cop named HO TIT-NAM (Philip Ng), who relentlessly probes into the matter. It turns out that TIT-NAM made an unspeakable mistake on impulse, resulting in a radical change of his personality. With the boxing championship rousing their combative instincts, the gradual discovery of their telepathic abilities enables them to help each other through that common bond. Such an underlying close connection can even be traced back to a financial crisis twenty years ago……

programme.title: I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: LUNG SEI (Kent Cheng) of the “Con Eight” is thrown in jail after being framed by Chinese Chief Detective MAN HUNG (Kent Tong) and his senior PONG FUNG (Paul Chun). MAN HUNG even steals his girlfriend PAK-HOP (Angie Cheong). Five years later, now top producer LUNG SEI not only has SHU KEI (Choi Hon Yik) and MAK KEI (James Ng) as his right-hand men, but is also reunited with his daughter SIU-YU (Ada Wong). After the murder of his fellow alum TONG WAI (Wong Pak Man), LUNG SEI believes his disciple AH-LONG (Edward Ma) is the culprit, triggering a gambling showdown between them…… SIU-YU confesses to dancing teacher PAK-HOP about her crush on aspiring director HO KA-CHUN (Dominic Ho), leading to a serendipitous reunion of PAK-HOP and LUNG SEI. PAK-HOP steals MAN HUNG's account book detailing illegal transactions and money laundering to elope with LUNG SEI, but they are crushed by MAN HUNG who is furious about this. As LUNG SEI is escorted to jail, he is released by a mystery man. They set a trap, pledging to lure the all-powerful MAN HUNG into it……

Originally inseparable siblings, they drifted apart as the tides of time turned and the future became unpredictable. Yet, a belief remained deeply ingrained in their shared blood, and no matter how bitter or difficult the trials, they eventually reunited on a new and vibrant path...

programme.title: Every Step You Take
programme.desc: Due to an accident, magazine photographer SUNG TIN-CHUNG (Myolie Wu) not only lost her parents but also her sight. Nevertheless, born to be aesthete, TIN-CHUNG, who loves binge-watching TV drama, never gives up on herself. Accompanied by her boyfriend TO CHING-HENG (Jonathan Cheung) and a guide dog, she gradually rebuilds her lost confidence, and an advertising slogan "With Love, Nothing is Impossible" even becomes her motto, helping her let go of her sorrows. Unknown to her, the advertising producer, KAM YIN-CHUNG (Moses Chan), is actually her next-door neighbour. Work addict YIN-CHUNG cannot keep friends and co-workers, not even his apprentice YUEN YUEN (Elaine Yiu), who wants to resign. Feeling rather puzzled, YIN-CHUNG decides to take a long vacation and move back to his former residence, and in the meantime to get back in touch with his old friend YU KA-KING (Mak Cheung Ching). While it's the best opportunity for YIN-CHUNG to start anew, it also helps him gain a better understanding of himself. With her boyfriend having a change of heart, TIN-CHUNG is once again at the lowest ebb, fortunately, she still has YIN-CHUNG by her side as her guardian angel. Though they are poles apart in personality, the chemistry between them ignites the spark of love. So you think you can see? However, there might still be a blind spot. Whereas vision impairment doesn't deter one from seeing the light......

programme.title: Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: After completion of a three-year undercover operation, Sit Ka-keung (Raymond Lam) returns to Hong Kong, opens a foot massage place and continues to gather intelligence. Criminal Intelligence Bureau (CIB) Chief Inspector Cheung Kei-gee (Mandy Wong) keeps Cheuk Hoi (Michael Miu) under close surveillance as she suspects Cheuk Hoi has become a gangster after being released from prison. Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi are drawn into an organ trafficking case. They team up with female decoy Dou Ah-hei (Sisley Choi) and Security Bureau Investigator Wai Chok-wing (Kenneth Ma) to crack down on the syndicate involved. Security Bureau then sets up Security Intelligence Agnecy and invites Chui Tin-tong (Benjamin Yuen) to join their team and take the helm of CIB. Chum Foon-hei (Hui Shiu Hung) has managed to escaped death. He then covertly investigates secrets of some gang. Ngai Tak-lai, younger brother of deceased Cheung Hing head Victor, is actually the founder of the mysterious society. He is also plotting to take revenge on Ka-keung and Cheuk Hoi.

programme.title: Executioner, The
programme.desc: In order to protect his benefactor's daughter-in-law, YUEN SO-SUM (Elaine Yiu), throughout her pregnancy and childbirth, cold-blooded executioner YIP SHEUNG-LUK (Kenny Wong) arranges for SO-SUM to settle down in the home of a renowned midwife in town, FA YUI-HUNG (Maggie Shiu). As such, they run into an obscure murder, and SHEUNG-LUK even uses his saber to help save a new life. Due to the unknown background of this newborn baby boy, SHEUNG-LUK and YUI-HUNG are involuntarily caught up in the whirlwind of political infighting. As a team, they play cohesively and competently despite being poles apart in personality, managing to avert disaster over and over again. Slowly, their love grows in the face of adversity. On the other hand, childhood sweethearts CHIK CHI-TSAU (Matt Yeung) and CHUK SIU-MOON (Katy Kung), who grow up together in a brothel, arrive at YUI-HUNG's home, beseeching SHEUNG-LUK to take CHI-TSAU as his apprentice. In fact, CHI-TSAU is up to something as he attempts to take advantage of this to avoid punishment, so SHEUNG-LUK cannot make up his mind. With the sudden appearance of a mysterious magician, SZEMA CAU (Joel Chan), they all get entangled in complicated relationships. Gradually, the real identity of the baby boy is unmasked, sounding the death knell in the meantime......

programme.title: I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: LUNG SEI (Kent Cheng) of the “Con Eight” is thrown in jail after being framed by Chinese Chief Detective MAN HUNG (Kent Tong) and his senior PONG FUNG (Paul Chun). MAN HUNG even steals his girlfriend PAK-HOP (Angie Cheong). Five years later, now top producer LUNG SEI not only has SHU KEI (Choi Hon Yik) and MAK KEI (James Ng) as his right-hand men, but is also reunited with his daughter SIU-YU (Ada Wong). After the murder of his fellow alum TONG WAI (Wong Pak Man), LUNG SEI believes his disciple AH-LONG (Edward Ma) is the culprit, triggering a gambling showdown between them…… SIU-YU confesses to dancing teacher PAK-HOP about her crush on aspiring director HO KA-CHUN (Dominic Ho), leading to a serendipitous reunion of PAK-HOP and LUNG SEI. PAK-HOP steals MAN HUNG's account book detailing illegal transactions and money laundering to elope with LUNG SEI, but they are crushed by MAN HUNG who is furious about this. As LUNG SEI is escorted to jail, he is released by a mystery man. They set a trap, pledging to lure the all-powerful MAN HUNG into it……

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life. This program showcases folk culture regardless of race or religion, and presents travel information in a fun way, combining easy-to-understand folk culture knowledge with the mission of passing on folk culture. The audience can learn more about folk cultural products such as handicrafts, antiques, temple folklore, as well as short stories about the gods, and information about local tourism. It is an educational and entertaining way to travel and learn about folklore.

programme.desc: Senior Inspector Bang sends Officer Ming undercover to a drug cartel to displace drug lord Yang. A failed raid triggers Yang's rage for revenge. Meanwhile, drug maker Ying Xiu is forced to cooperate with the police and sets a trap for Yang. The battle between the police and the drug cartel has just begun!

programme.title: Cape No. 7
programme.desc: A Taiwanese singer tries to deliver seven old love letters attentioned to a Tomoko. As he falls in love with a young Japanese model also named Tomoko, he unravels their serendipitous connection.

programme.title: Band Four
programme.desc: An aspiring singer of an indie band called Band Four reunites with her estranged guitarist father following the death of her mother. Together with her half-sister and her nine-year-old son, the newly reunited family come together to support each other through their love and passion for music.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Wu Kong

programme.desc: A hijacking of a police van occurs when the Police Commissioner is away from Hong Kong. Deputy Commissioner Lee leads a rescue operation code-named Cold War. Fellow Deputy Commissioner Sean moves to take control from Lee as he thinks Lee is emotionally affected by his son being held hostage, but the efforts end up threatening both their reputation.

programme.title: Someday Or One Day
programme.desc: The movie is a spin-off from the TV series of the same name. While Huang Yu Xuan mourns the death of her boyfriend, she receives a mysterious cassette player that allows her to travel back in time. She meets her boyfriend then again, but will she be able to change his destiny?

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the “midnight gymnasium” programme for wayward teenage girls is at funding risk, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match and save it. With an ex-star athlete John as the coach, the girls realize they must face their problems and overcome their challenges instead of dodging them. Can they finally win the match?

programme.title: The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: A crooked watch dealer assembles a daring crew - a thief, an explosive expert, a lock breaker and a watch connoisseur - to steal three luxury watches in Tokyo. Their mission takes an unexpected turn when they discover the legendary 'Moonwatch.' Pursued by the yakuza, the team must unite to navigate the chaos and pull off their high-stakes heist.

programme.title: All Suspects
programme.desc: A policeman on leave checks into a B&B, sharing the space with a detective novelist, a homeless drifter and a pianist. However, when the owner and the receptionist are found dead, the peaceful retreat turns into a web of suspicion and deceit. Each guest becomes both suspect and sleuth—each guarding a secret that could unravel the entire mystery.

programme.title: Golden Boy
programme.desc: After a decade in prison, former boxer Cheung Lek meets his son for the first time. Forced to live together for an inheritance, the estranged pair struggles to rebuild trust. As Cheung Lek returns to the ring for one last shot at redemption, he must confront his past and fight for a future with his son.

programme.title: The Sleep Curse
programme.desc: During the Japanese occupation of Hong Kong, a young translator colluded with the enemy and was cursed by a murdered comfort woman. Forty five years later, the translator's son who is a professor specializing in sleeping disorder does not believe in the sleep curse on his father and tries to dispel it with a horrifying sleep experiment.

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit
programme.desc: Three devastated parents, pushed to the edge by the abduction of their children, forge a fierce alliance in the barren deserts. Driven by fury and grief, they embark on a lawless, violent crusade to hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate. Can they shatter the criminal ring and bring their children home alive?

programme.title: We are Family
programme.desc: Struggling as an extra, Chi Kwong joins a rent-a-family company run by Carlos and aspiring actress Catherine, and rent themselves out as make-believe relatives. As they surrogate different families, they unravel the complexities of family relationships, forging deeper connections along the way.

programme.title: Don't Forget I Love You
programme.desc: Lu Yao suffers from amnesia and forgets about everything that happens yesterday when he wakes up the next day. When Lu Yao meets psychotherapist Xing Yue, they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together, and are determined to love each other no matter what happens...

programme.title: Way We Talk, The
programme.desc: This is a soul-searching story about three youths: Wolf, Sophie and Alan, each living with a different form of deafness. Through sign language, they cultivate a profound friendship and offer each other unwavering support. United by love and friendship, the trio embarks on a journey of self-discovery and resilience.

programme.title: The Monkey King
programme.desc: After Goddess Nuwa sacrifices herself to save the mortal world, Monkey King comes into being from one of her crystals. Powerful and uncontrollable, Monkey King challenges the Jade Emperor and causes an uproar in heaven, unwittingly creating an opportunity for the wicked Buffalo Demon King to wage war in heaven.

programme.title: Oversteer
programme.desc: Adapted from a true story, the film follows Feng, a determined young man who defies his father to pursue his dream of becoming an automotive mechanic. Alongside his childhood friend Yun, he embarks on a daring journey that unexpectedly plunges them into the exhilarating world of racing, sparking a passionate coming-of-age adventure.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from To's father and bitter jealousy from her designated fiancé, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: My First of May
programme.desc: Former squash champion Teng and his wife face devastating trials when their daughter is diagnosed with muscular dystrophy and his mother with cancer. Years later, as the family struggles between holding on and letting go, they find a new connection through a small but powerful sign of hope: the faint movement of their daughter's pinky finger.

programme.title: Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: The only daughter of Inspector Yan is brutally murdered, and her classmate Wen is arrested. Believing the case closed, Yan leaves the police force. However, when more girls are killed after Wen's imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect the real killer is still at large and vows to find the truth.

programme.title: Lelio PoPo
programme.desc: Former radio DJs KK and Ah Luke were once hugely popular, but their bad attitudes and eccentric behaviour got them fired. Desperate for a comeback, they audition for a new radio station searching for elderly female hosts. Disguising themselves as old ladies, the pair unexpectedly land the job and spark a series of hilarious misadventures.

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wang's odd behaviour and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. His teenage nephew Zhou, who is ashamed of his stutter, becomes Wang's only friend. Together, these misfits challenge traditional family expectations and social misunderstandings, supporting and inspiring each other as they seek their own paths in life.

programme.title: The Myth
programme.desc: Guided by mysterious dreams, archaeologist Jack discovers he was General Meng Yi in a past life and shared a tragic love with Princess Ok-Soo that spanned a thousand years. When they reunite in Emperor Qin's celestial palace, a ruthless tycoon seeks the secret of immortality. Reclaiming his past strength, Jack faces a final battle of destiny.

programme.title: In Broad Daylight
programme.desc: Based on a true event of a news investigative unit receiving a tip-off about the abuse of residents in an Elderly and Disabled Care Home. To expose the home's wrongdoings, reporter Kay goes undercover to expose the inhumanity and unveil the cruel truth under broad daylight.

programme.title: Beauty And The 7 Beasts
programme.desc: Teddy, once a renowned movie star, is facing a career decline. To make a living, he accepts five disciples to shape them into stars. Teddy's career regains momentum after he reunites with his long-lost daughter, but he is also confronted by a rival at the same time. His daughter and disciples decide to help him overcome this difficult situation…

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen.

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”.

programme.title: Pavane For An Infant
programme.desc: In a conservative society, a baby hatch that never closes sparks fierce moral controversy and public backlash. Despite mounting criticism and pressure, Lai Sum, Fatimah, Kam Jie and Nuru remain steadfast in their mission to protect desperate mothers with nowhere else to turn, while offering abandoned newborns a fragile chance at life and hope.

programme.title: Back to the Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself.

programme.title: The Monkey King 2
programme.desc: Monkey King is tasked with escorting Monk Tang on his journey to the West to retrieve the scriptures. During the trip, Monk Tang is being targeted by the seductive yet deadly White Bone Spirit, who feeds on the innocents to gain immortality. Monkey King will have to fight the White Bone Spirit in order to save Monk Tang!

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Peng and Mang have nothing in common but spend a magical night in Rome together. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: The infamous “Gang Trio” is hired to kidnap a baby for 30 million. When they discover the triad intends to seize the ransom and kill the child, they take the baby under their wing. Cornered by cops and hunted by gangsters, the three “Rob-B-Hood” must put the baby safely back in his cradle.

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: The sequel to "Table for Six", Bernard and Lung plan to get married while their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for everyone involved.

programme.title: Wolf Hiding
programme.desc: A cold-blooded killer, Chen An vows to take revenge for her sister who was killed by a crime gang. Dealing with the police and the triad at the same time, a final battle between good and evil has just begun!

programme.title: Under Current
programme.desc: A charity gala turns deadly when the finance director is found dead and HK$200 million in donations vanish. Lawyer Ma Ying Fung joins an inspector to uncover a web of money laundering and murder.

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman
programme.desc: Longing to leave the martial world behind, Linghu Chong is drawn into a fierce conflict between rival factions. He falls for the enigmatic Dongfang Bubai, whose secret acts of kindness save him. But manipulated by Ren Wo Xing into believing she slaughtered his fellow disciples, Linghu Chong is driven into a tragic, life-or-death showdown.

programme.title: Silent Code
programme.desc: Reporter Lan is tasked to research news from the internet, and stumbles across a popular BBS forum, Dream Board. The forum founder Xiang, creates space for netizens to share dreams and ideas, but ends up being the subject of a heated debate due to a leaked video. As Lan digs for the truth, she finds that things more complicated than they seem...

programme.title: Cesium Fallout
programme.desc: A massive fire caused by illegal garbage smuggling has triggered a radiation crisis in Hong Kong. Government advisor Simon joins the crisis response team led by Acting Chief Executive to avert the disaster. A fire brigade is tasked to enter the radiation zone and stop the cesium fallout. Facing the unprecedented catastrophe, can they save the city?

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: A school bus accident kills almost everyone on board. The bus driver got injured and partially lost his memory while rescuing one of the boys. To thank the driver, the boy's dad, Wang, brings him to live with the family in their basement. However, the driver soon discovers strange behaviours from the Wang's which seem to be related to the accident.

programme.title: Tainted Love
programme.desc: Office lady Zhou Ran falls victim to an online dating love scam and is cheated of 550,000 yuan. Following faint clues left by the scammer, Zhou Ran comes to a small coastal town and encounters two young men. She gradually discovers that these two men have hidden the clues of the scam, and sets out on her revenge plan.

programme.title: Ready O/R Knot
programme.desc: Guy and Heidi have been together for five years since they first met in a wedding banquet, but marriage soon becomes a challenge to their relationship. Heidi sees marriage as a testimony of their love, while Guy sees it as doomsday. Can the couple resolve their conflict? Are they ready or not?

programme.title: Hand Rolled Cigarette
programme.desc: A retired British-Chinese soldier becomes a target in a triad manhunt when he takes in a young South Asian man who carries a bag of stolen drugs. Forced to live together, the two men transcend conflicts and cultural differences to form a beautiful friendship in this poignant tale of loyalty and brotherhood.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: Sam is a charismatic tycoon who has been divorced three times. When he meets Milan, a cabaret dancer and croupier, they immediately fall in love. However, their romance faces challenges when he proposes a prenuptial agreement, putting their budding relationship at risk.

programme.title: Behind the Shadows
programme.desc: Private detective Ouyang uncovers his wife's betrayal during an investigation. Reeling from the shock, he abandons a missing person case. Soon after, the missing person turns up dead. Inspector Chen suspects a serial killer may be at large. Now drawn back into the case, Ouyang must use his skills to stop the killer before another life is taken.

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman
programme.desc: Longing to leave the martial world behind, Linghu Chong is drawn into a fierce conflict between rival factions. He falls for the enigmatic Dongfang Bubai, whose secret acts of kindness save him. But manipulated by Ren Wo Xing into believing she slaughtered his fellow disciples, Linghu Chong is driven into a tragic, life-or-death showdown.

programme.title: An Abandoned Team
programme.desc: Uncle Jia is bad-tempered and lives alone. His forced retirement, failed marriage and strained relationship with his daughter have left him in despair, prompting him to consider ending his life. Fortunately, he is rescued by a stray dog and an animal welfare volunteer, allowing him to rediscover his purpose in life.

programme.title: Cold War 2
programme.desc: Sean Lau is now the Police Commissioner after the successful rescue operation Cold War. However, the culprits from the past not only dodged justice but even escalated their actions and kidnapped Lau's wife. He breaks every protocol to get her back, which puts him under investigation.

programme.title: Mama's Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with "The Five Venoms" actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys from the villainous clan and it's so filled with "don't-blink-or-you-will-miss-something" gags, you will need to watch it over and over again so you can see the things you missed.

programme.title: Operation Lipstick
programme.desc: A professor's assistant stole a micro-film storing the secret of a newly invented nuclear reactor and sells it to a crime syndicate. However, the micro-film accidentally falls into the hands of a nightclub dancer and a thief in the process, leading to them being relentlessly pursued by the crime syndicate to retrieve the micro-film.

programme.title: Legendary Weapons Of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung's brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back…

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master's birthday.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Dr. He moves to the remote Lanyu island off the coast of Taiwan to look for his long lost father, and starts to run a clinic curing islanders who are bitten by the fatal red worms there. He meets Ya Lan who works as a nurse in his clinic and falls in love with him. Things get vicious for Dr. He as a jealous islander plots to get rid of him…

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tian's rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tian's granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death.

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: The Magnificent Trio
programme.desc: A group of farmers who are being oppressed by the local magistrates kidnap one of the magistrate's daughter in the hope of being heard by the authorities. A wandering swordsman offers his help and aiding him are two fighters who have both switched sides from being the oppressors to the oppressed. The trio fight back against the magistrates!

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: Raw Courage
programme.desc: After the Ming Emperor is overthrown and his infant son was put in the care of the Black Dragon Society, a traitorous martial arts clan attacks the society, forcing an inexperienced pair of swordsman and swordswoman to flee with the infant. Their journey to deliver the infant to safety is filled with dangers that would require help from other allies…

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy “House of 72 tenants”, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barber's apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the "yin and yang combination" to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of 'scaffolding kung fu”.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Lady is the Boss
programme.desc: Mei, a young overseas Chinese woman, returns to Hong Kong to take over a traditional martial arts school. Her modern management style clashes with her conservative senior disciple, sparking disputes and attracting local gangsters. Forced to put aside their differences, they join forces to fight back and defend the school's honour.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: This film is an amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry and is based on Director Li Han Hsiang's popular newspaper column recounting his work at Shaw Brothers. The collection of some of his funniest and most surreal film musings of the era, filled with behind-the-scene asides, this is a must-see for any Hong Kong cinema aficionado!

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuan's original hit.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: The Weird Man
programme.desc: During the Three Kingdoms period, a Taoist priest Yu Ji cures many patients with his supernatural powers and is loved by the people. However, the arrogant general Sun Che thinks that Yu Ji bewitches people and orders for him to be beheaded. Subsequently, the spirit of the Yu Ji rises from his dead body and takes revenge on Sun Che.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: In this surprisingly light-hearted "Venoms" martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Master Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: The famous kung fu master Wong Fei Hung teaches martial arts in Guangdong. A vicious gangster plots to harm Wong's disciples and frames him for robbery and murder. Wong has to fight against the culprit to prove his own innocence and take revenge for his disciples.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily finds help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: When The Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his father's martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hung's passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lu's disciple.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: Yun Fei Yang, a Wudang servant hiding his identity as the sect leader's illegitimate son, is framed by long-hidden enemies and branded a traitor after losing his father. Hunted by rival forces and stripped of his martial arts, he masters the legendary “Tian Chan Gong” and rises again to clear his name and settle a generations-old blood feud.

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Bao's chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer?

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlong's younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles…

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponent's son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chan's elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

programme.title: Na Cha The Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend “Investiture of the Gods”, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: The Kingdom And The Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love…

programme.title: Sivalinga
programme.desc: Raheem gets killed when he tries to save a blind man in a train. When the police close the case stating suicide, Raheem's girlfriend asks Shivalingeshwaran, a CID officer, to investigate the death.

programme.title: Theru Rowdy
programme.desc: A misunderstood man branded a rowdy fights to protect his community while seeking justice, battling corrupt forces in a gritty tale of defiance.

programme.title: Wild Dog
programme.desc: A series of deadly attacks occur that pose a threat to national security. In response, a brash but brilliant intelligence agent leads a covert operation to find the perpetrators.

programme.title: The Factory Wonders
programme.desc: This time, we explore a Nanbu ironware factory blending traditional moulds and casting techniques with modern design. See masterful skills and a president's passion for ironware re-imagined for today.

programme.title: Hagi
programme.desc: Hagi, a World Heritage site of ten described as an "open-air museum," is lined with merchant and samurai houses and retains much of its 17th-century townscape. Soak in the atmosphere, in time-lapse.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK NEWSLINE brings you up to date with the latest from Japan, Asia and around the world. Our team covers breaking news and major developments, with trusted anchors to tie it all together.

programme.title: Grand Sumo Highlights
programme.desc: NHK WORLD-JAPAN presents a sumo highlights programme for fans around the globe. Today the show features all top-division bouts from September 14, Day 2 of the Grand Sumo Tournament in Tokyo.

programme.title: Sumopedia
programme.desc: Sumopedia enriches your sumo experience with information on the techniques, traditions and famous wrestlers of the past. The rules may be simple but there is a lot more to sumo than meets the eye.

programme.desc: We highlight shows promoting J-pop internationally: "SCHOOL OF J-POP," which explores the genre's global success, and "tiny desk concerts JAPAN."

programme.title: Direct Talk
programme.desc: Kosaka Kunpei holds multiple world records in spearfishing, a sport in which competitors hunt underwater and see who can catch the biggest fish. He talks about freediving and using a hand spear.

programme.title: Matsuri: The Heartbeat of Japan
programme.desc: Participants of the Hyoge Festival clown around in fun, silly costumes. It originated as a sly way of thanking a local hero, who built reservoirs but was exiled in the 17th century.

programme.title: Ukiyo-e Edo-Life
programme.desc: We come across a tranquil, snow-covered Edo cityscape. But there's something in the air: the aroma of foods both sweet and savoury that helped the townspeople keep warm in the winter.

programme.title: Today's Close-Up
programme.desc: Forty-one years after a Japan Airlines crash that claimed 520 lives, questions continue to swirl. NHK looks at the conflict between fact-finding and pursuit of liability at the heart of the case.

programme.desc: This programme visits places across Japan to introduce the charms of their local daily life and festivals fostered by the nation's long history.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua atlet MMA, Adam dan Johan, yang merupakan musuh dalam dan luar gelanggang. programme.title: KONA MAI 2026
programme.desc: Rehatkan minda anda pada penghujung hari bersama Shah, Faruk & Mimie dalam segmen KONA MAI. Segmen ini membawakan pilihan lagu santai, pengisian rohani, serta seleksi lagu-lagu kesukaan anda di Tapaw Lagu @ Kafe Muzik. Sebelum melelapkan mata, nikmati alunan lagu-lagu melankolik terkini, bahasa Melayu, Inggeris, dan Indonesia untuk menemani malam anda dengan penuh kedamaian.

programme.title: GENG PAGI MUTIARA
programme.desc: Mulakan Pagi anda dengan penuh bersemangat bersama Chombi dan Bambam!\\n Segmen ini menyajikan gabungan lengkap untuk memulakan hari anda dengan positif—daripada pengisian rohani menerusi bacaan Al-Quran, nasyid, dan Santai Nurani, hinggalah kepada berita sahih, laporan trafik semasa, tajuk-tajuk akhbar utama, serta topik pagi yang santai dan menghiburkan. Jangan lupa layan lagu-lagu permintaan anda dalam slot Layan Pagi sebelum melangkah ke tengah hari!

programme.title: FOKUS MUTIARA
programme.desc: Sambil buat kerja atau berehat, penyampai kami Azie, Elly , Mimie & Fazrinah sedia menemani dengan pelbagai maklumat berguna dan hiburan menarik. Dapatkan petua serta tips gaya hidup serta pelbagai perkongsian harian yang terkini. Nikmati juga kelainan irama Bollywood menerusi Syoknya Hindi & mengimbau memori menerusi Everlasting Memory dengan lagu retro Inggeris terbaik serta laporan berita Warta Mutiara secara langsung bagi memastikan anda sentiasa peka dengan isu semasa.

programme.title: PETANG KREW
programme.desc: Petang anda pastinya tidak hambar bersama gandingan serasi Amin , Que , Mimie dan Fazrinah! Sambil melayan perjalanan pulang dari kerja, dapatkan pengisian Mutiara Ilmu, tips keusahawanan dalam Biz On Air, serta bincangkan pelbagai Isu hangat dan menarik menerusi Ralet Cheq. Tak lengkap petang anda tanpa menguji minda dalam peraduan Teka Tiara Nyanyi bersama kemaskini trafik dan berita terkini.

programme.title: TAHSIN AL-QURAN
programme.desc: “Tahsin Al-Quran” di Perlis FM membimbing pendengar memperindahkan bacaan Al-Quran melalui teknik yang mudah, jelas, dan berkesan. Disampaikan secara santai tetapi penuh pengisian, segmen ini membantu meningkatkan sebutan, tajwid, dan keyakinan dalam membaca Al-Quran dengan lebih baik.

programme.title: CERITA ORANG PERLIS 612
programme.desc: Cerita Orang Perlis merupakan segmen malam Perlis FM yang bersiaran dari jam 6.00 petang hingga 12.00 tengah malam. Segmen ini mengetengahkan perkongsian suara dan pandangan masyarakat setempat, disertai muzik pilihan serta perbincangan santai yang mencerminkan gaya dan identiti orang Perlis.

programme.title: SANTAI 5-8
programme.desc: Segmen Santai 5-8 mengandungi zon muzik segmen Lagu 60 an pada Isnin Laguku Kuasa Dua pada Selasa Rabu Lagu dan Kenangan Khamis Secangkir Bicara/Nurul Al-Quran dan Jumaat La Khobar. Sabtu dan Ahad segmen Hello Hello MELAKAfm pilihan lagu dan ucapan pendengar

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Info trafik(call out) dan Topik Gegau Pagi interaktif bersama pendengar.Kokenut Shake Dulu Special (Temubual/Zon Iklan menyusul selepasnya. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat.
